title: UX Audit
summary: A UX audit combines heuristic inspection, accessibility, analytics and user evidence to prioritize risks.

MUST.text: Audit critical journeys end-to-end including empty, error, permission, loading and responsive states.

SHOULD.text: Separate observed defect, inferred risk and untested hypothesis.

AVOID.text: Do not issue generic scores without scope, evidence and severity.

EXAMPLE.good: Audit sign-up through first value, not only the form
EXAMPLE.bad: Score homepage 8/10 with no scope or evidence

FAILURE_MODES: Audits that skip error/permission states miss critical failures; include them.
Severity inflation reduces trust; calibrate with impact and reach.
Mixing observation with inference hides uncertainty; label each.

sources.title: NN/g How to Conduct a Heuristic Evaluation
